Pre-Flight

Your discipline trainer. Define the confluences your trigger requires, run a pre-flight check before every trade, and let the data show which confluences performed best in your own records.

How Pre-Flight works
1
Build your checklist

List the exact confluences your entry trigger requires — your own rules, in your own words.

2
Run it before every trade

Tick what's present right now. The lamp shows GO, CAUTION or NO-GO based on your own checklist — a discipline aid, not a signal or recommendation.

3
Log the trade and learn

Add the date, instrument, R:R and result — backtests or live papertrades. Over time the stats show which confluences performed best in your own records.

Your Checklists

Save your personal trigger as a checklist preset and reuse it before every trade. Start from a built-in template or build your own.

New checklist
01 Name this checklist

This is just your own label — it never changes the confluences below.

02 Start from a preset (optional)

Picking a preset only fills the confluence list below with example rows — edit, add or delete any of them afterwards.

03 Your confluences

One confluence per row — the conditions you check before pulling the trigger.

04 Verdict thresholds

How many ticked confluences turn the lamp GO or CAUTION?

Pre-Flight Check —

Tick every confluence that is present right now — then trust the verdict.
